topic: Your car hesitates when you hit the gas — here's one clue why

beats.narration: Car hesitates when you step on the gas — feels like it's thinking about it?
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a gas pedal at rest, cut to a tachometer needle hesitating/dipping as the car is put in gear, dim interior lighting, shallow depth of field, static-mounted camera.

beats.narration: A little stumble on acceleration, maybe a rough idle at a stoplight.
beats.visualPrompt: Low-angle shot of an idling engine bay under the hood with a slight rough tremor; cut to a stoplight scene through the windshield, engine note uneven.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two ~2.5s sub-shots before real generation to satisfy the 1.5-2.5s visual-change cadence.

beats.narration: One clue: a dirty airflow sensor. It can send the wrong signal about how much air is coming in.
beats.visualPrompt: Macro/cutaway shot: a mass airflow sensor removed from its intake tube housing, resting on a workbench, visible dust/oil film on the sensor element, slow push-in.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots (wide + macro push-in) before real generation.

beats.narration: That can throw off the fuel mix — engine hesitates instead of responding.
beats.visualPrompt: Close-up on a fuel-trim / air-flow readout on an OBD-II scan-tool screen, values fluctuating erratically, screen glow in a dim shop bay, tool mounted/clipped in frame.

beats.narration: Don't guess which part it is. A scan tool can help narrow it down.
beats.visualPrompt: Scan tool connected via cable under the dash, live data scrolling on-screen, shop bay softly blurred in the background.
beats.renderIntegrityNote: Split into two sub-shots before real generation.

beats.narration: Worth checking before it gets worse. Stop by and we'll take a look. Nick's Tire & Auto.
beats.visualPrompt: Branded end-card plate: Nick's Tire & Auto shop bay wide shot, warm daylight, static hold.
